cards.title: Continuum bichromatic Hamiltonian
cards.latex: H/E_r^p=-pi^{-2} partial_s^2+(v_p/2)cos(2 pi s)+(v_d/2)cos(2 pi alpha s+phi)
cards.role: Defines the independently solved physical model.

checks.reason: s=x/(lambda_p/2) gives the kinetic coefficient 1/pi^2 in primary-recoil units.

cards.title: Second-order real-space discretization
cards.role: Produces the tridiagonal matrix used by every target.

checks.reason: The linked theory paper states that the continuum coordinate is discretized on a converged fine mesh.
The stencil has O(h^2) convergence to the free-particle dispersion.

open_questions: The paper does not report its mesh density.

cards.title: Tunnelling-time conversion
cards.role: Maps paper times in tau to spectral phases.
open_questions: The target paper does not report a numerical J table; J is independently calculated from the primary band.

checks.reason: Definition is stated in the main text.
A pure one-parity CDW gives I(0)=1.

cards.title: Center-third edge density

checks.reason: Main text defines the initially populated center third and D=1-Nc/N.
Normalizing by the same projected representation's Nc(0) gives D(0)=0 and removes lowest-band truncation leakage.

open_questions: The target paper does not state every boundary-condition detail for the center-third preparation.

cards.title: Spectral one-body propagation

source_refs.value: spectral theorem for a real symmetric single-particle Hamiltonian

cards.latex: <W>_t=sum_ab W'_ab R'_ba exp[i(lambda_a-lambda_b)t]; overline{<W>}=sum_a W'_aa R'_aa
cards.role: Propagates finite-time projectors and evaluates stationary diagonal-ensemble curves without an author code path.

checks.reason: The paper specifies unitary time evolution under Eq. (1).
At t=0 the contraction reduces to Tr(W rho0); its infinite-time average retains only equal-energy diagonal terms.

cards.title: FWHM and RMS cloud observables

source_refs.value: Comparison of different observables for the expansion

cards.role: Generates Supplementary Fig. S1 cloud-size panels.

checks.reason: Supplement defines FWHM and describes the RMS observable; its displayed right-hand expression omits the stated square root.
The implemented outer square root returns a length in sites.

open_questions: The supplement's printed RMS equation is internally inconsistent; the standard dimensionally correct form is used.

cards.title: Gaussian-beam tube averaging proxy
cards.latex: <O>_tube=sum_ij (4 w_i w_j/pi) O(f_ij V_p,f_ij V_d), f_ij=exp[-(w_y^2 u_i^2+w_z^2 v_j^2)/w_b^2]
cards.role: Tests the reported broadening caused by correlated depth reduction away from the central tube.

checks.reason: Supplement reports w=150 um, wy=42 um, wz=12 um and atom-number weighting.
Deterministic quadrature weights are nonnegative and normalized.

cards.numerical_form: order-(8,4) product Gauss-Hermite beam-depth quadrature (eight merged nodes) with an order-(10,6) fifteen-node convergence profile
open_questions: Exact per-tube atom histogram, fitted-width convention and lattice-beam alignment are not published; affected rows remain a method-derived proxy.
